note: No statewide general-contractor license, and most NH municipalities have none either. The only state-level artifact is Home Improvement Contractor registration (residential jobs >$1,000) -- a liability-insurance/consumer-protection requirement, not a competency license (same shape as PA's HIC registration). Electricians (RSA 319-C) and plumbers (RSA 329-B) are separately licensed trades, not construction_trades (2026-07-08, hand-verified).
